title: AI service: fewer glibc memory arenas (MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2)
note: OPTIONAL and NOT MEASURED. Install with: --with algo-app-malloc. The AI service (Python, many threads) may keep freed memory in several malloc arenas; one setting limits them to 2. Typical gain is 0 to a few dozen MB; the cost is slightly slower allocation. Meant to be tried on one print and compared with the memory log of algo_app (/var/log/algo_app, 'process mem' lines). Remove by uninstalling the module.
